title: Turkish-Style Tofu Kebap with Molten Cheese
description: A fusion twist on traditional Turkish kebap, featuring crispy tofu and gooey molten cheese, all with a Mexican flair.

ingredients.name: Gooey Molten Cheese
ingredients.notes: Mexican string cheese or Monterey Jack work well

ingredients.name: Turkish-Style Kebap Seasoning
ingredients.notes: A blend of cumin, coriander, and paprika

ingredients.name: Adana Kebap Spice
ingredients.notes: A blend of chili peppers, garlic, and cumin

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together Turkish-Style Kebap Seasoning and Adana Kebap Spice.
Toss the cubed tofu with the spice blend until well coated.
Grill the seasoned tofu for 3-4 minutes per side, or until crispy and golden.
Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add the shredded molten cheese and stir until melted and gooey.
Warm the Mexican corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the kebap by placing a portion of tofu onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of the melted cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Optional: Add a sprinkle of cilantro or a squeeze of lime juice for extra flavor.
